props.title: Privacy Policy
props.subtitle: Personal data, cookies, consent and third-party services.

props.text: This policy explains how Bezot Corp handles personal data that may be collected when visiting bezotcorp.com.
The website may process technical data required for its operation, such as IP address, browser information, technical logs, language preferences and consent choices.

The website uses a consent management platform to collect, store and communicate user choices related to cookies, trackers, personalized advertising, audience measurement and third-party services when such processing is enabled.
Cookies or trackers that are not strictly necessary are used according to the choices expressed by the user through the consent interface.

The website may display affiliate links, external content or advertisements provided by third-party partners. These partners may process certain data under their own privacy policies when their services are loaded or used.
Affiliate links may allow Bezot Corp to earn a commission if the user performs an action or makes a purchase after following a partner link, without any announced additional cost for the user.
The user may change consent choices at any time through the consent interface when it is available on the website.
Depending on the applicable law, the user may request access, rectification, deletion, restriction or objection to the processing of personal data when these rights apply.
For any privacy or personal data request, the user may contact Bezot Corp at contact@bezotcorp.com.
